scope: Cold numeric metadata planning only; no transactions, proofs, or GPU execution.

implementation.compiler_storage: Checked u32 wire references only in compiler interning maps; randomized hashing, full-key equality, original allocation accounting and public wire encoding retained. Unrepresentable inputs bypass interning for unchanged operation validation.
implementation.pool_lifetime: Up to 64 ready requests share a joined pool with at most 16 workers. Worker scratch remains reserved and retires before the original reservation ends. Caller frame arrays use the same shared bound.
implementation.placement: Spread allowed physical cores across L3 groups and initialize scratch after pinning; failures retain allowed inherited affinity and are counted.
implementation.concurrency: Automatic native ceiling 8; automatic registered ceiling up to 16 physical cores; explicit ceilings up to 16 retain memory admission.
implementation.notifications: Per-slot worker condition variables and a separate coordinator completion signal; wake every worker only during shutdown or failure.

method.host: AMD Ryzen 9 5900XT, 16 physical cores, 32 logical CPUs, 64 GiB nominal RAM
method.perf_scope: Whole metadata-only test process, including startup and teardown; wall timings separately cover the cold workload.
method.scheduling_scope: Worker lifetime getrusage(RUSAGE_THREAD) and /proc/thread-self/sched; includes initial pinning migrations.
method.scheduling_reason: User-only perf scheduling events returned misleading zeros under perf_event_paranoid=2; OS per-thread counters were used instead.
method.tables: Disabled for scaling; every mathematical result compared with the registered or native catalogue.

native_16_worker_memory.interpretation: The ceiling admits 16 active workers for lighter jobs; heavier windows remain memory-limited. Reservations are allocation bounds, not simultaneous RSS. Eight workers were faster for the full native catalogue.

limitations: These measurements do not establish end-to-end transaction or recursive-prover speedup.
Generic cache counters do not isolate bandwidth saturation or a particular cache level.
Placement and concurrency defaults were measured on this host; other hardware may differ.
Candidate performance source preceded the InvalidWire error-type fix and caller frame census correction; final source was rebuilt, requalified, and checked again with the final comparison receipts.
